readerEvidence.summary: One complete authorized original-source GPT-6.1 Sol ultra pass over all55 physical pages1–55 of the full291page Volume3 archive. This child preserves every native whole assignment, labelled request and complete supplied matching key, chemistry structures, graphs, tables, unfilled diagrams, grading alternatives and common front matter in its exact scoped pages. Actual final scientific crop bytes personally opened, versioned no-snap300DPI uploads and exact publicGET hashes verified. The two actual common cover/rights images are separate documentNote bindings. No independent model checker or ROOT inspection credit; full final MDX inspection must be separately frozen before handoff.
sourceGaps: This is Anton Sirota’s 2014 Volume3 collection edition, rather than an obtained original2009 competitor packet. Its preface explicitly describes normalized task numbering, omitted grading points/special practical grading graphs, omitted practical apparatus/chemicals/safety guidance as a general editorial policy, and omitted data-dependent solution portions. Every instruction, chemical list and grading graph that this Cambridge section actually prints is retained; no missing original-only material is invented.

The practical answer booklet, TLC plate template and associated paper for graph plotting are referenced but not supplied as separate originals in the complete four-PDF IChO folder. Practical1 also references a ¹³C NMR spectrum in the practical instructions; that spectrum is not in this obtained section. Blank responses and measured experimental data are not invented.

Practical2’s grading key supplies no numerical Vcorr or unique final complex formula: the evaluation depends on the competitor’s own titration data. Practical3’s stock concentration and CMC are evaluated from the actual sample mass/graph; only its literature fallback8.3mmol dm⁻³ is supplied.

The public source was obtained from an archive mirror. Printed IChO International Information Centre/IUVENTA attribution is preserved; organizer hosting and blanket permission for public archive reproduction are not proved. Teaching-copy/adaptation permission requires Volume3 attribution; commercial publication/distribution requires copyright-holder permission. ROOT must decide public reproduction eligibility from the actual rights statement.

Only source pages1–55 were authorized and personally read. The remaining236physical pages56–291 have not been rendered/extracted/read and the whole compilation queue cannot be resolved from these two scoped children.

sourceErrors.finding: Key1.11 prints acceptable slope0.0235±0.002 µm, although the plotted slope is negative and reciprocal-length units would be expected. The printed positive sign/unit and error-range comment are retained explicitly.
The key uses P0/P1/P2 where the question uses x0/x1/x2 and explicitly says remember P is changed to x. Both native notations are preserved. Native18 optional parenthesized ModelB check is retained.
The printed thiosulfate equation2Na2S2O3+I2→2NaI+Na2S4O6 is retained as printed even though its sodium count is unbalanced.

Printed key labels1.4/1.5/1.6 correspond to question1.5/1.6/1.7. Key explicitly prints Expect0.3mmol maximum with masses.895g and.841g, while procedure provides3mmol: these native discrepancies are visible and not silently corrected.

Retain the native spacing expressions in mmol as printed, full six alternative graph scores4/4,3/4,2/4,0/4,0/4,0/4, full bands1–5/outside5 and worked Region1/section2 example. No missing total score inferred.
